# Built-in anatomy definitions

These Built-in definitions apply to residual div/span nodes after Predefined platform roles.
They produce Defined roles: choosing the right meaning remains an author decision.

## text

A short textual run or UI copy without a more specific native role.

Examples: A label's visible text; A short hint.

Exclusions: An authored prose paragraph uses p; A heading uses its native mapping.

## icon

A wrapper for a glyph-sized pictogram.

Examples: An icon font glyph; A slot containing an icon.

Exclusions: A native svg keeps svg; A content image keeps image.

## media

A region grouping visual or audiovisual content.

Examples: Image and video content wrapper.

Exclusions: A native figure keeps figure; A generic layout wrapper.

## value

A read-only datum displayed as part of a UI.

Examples: A metric value; A selected value's text.

Exclusions: An editable input; A native output keeps output.

## field

A visible form-field or composite-control frame.

Examples: An input with affixes; A composite input frame with an externally associated label.

Exclusions: An arbitrary page region; A native fieldset keeps fieldset.

## actions

A group of related action controls.

Examples: Dialog action buttons; Card actions.

Exclusions: A single button keeps button; Navigation links with a native nav role.
